violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Minimum Height of 22 Inches from Top of Railing to Mattress Support at Lowest Level (26 TAC §747.2311(2)(E))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Minimum Height of 22 Inches from Top of Railing to Mattress Support at Lowest Level
violation_type.typical_finding: The two play pens used as the sleeping areas for two infants in care was raised and did not meet the 22 inch requirement. This was corrected at the inspection when the caregiver lowered the surface.

finding_variants.text: The two play pens used as the sleeping areas for two infants in care was raised and did not meet the 22 inch requirement. This was corrected at the inspection when the caregiver lowered the surface.

The provider was using the bassinet insert for the play yard which is less than 22 inches from top of the railing to the mattress. This was removed during inspection and the mattress was removed to put at the lowest level.
